coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass with 27 actual search invocations and 462 ordered headers, confirmed by exact comparison with the registered rollout. Thirty source cards are retained (2 current-unit body opens, 0 prior-unit-only consultations; both are scoped partial reads under compliant gates; 28 remain search-only). One candidate is a provisional proposed include supported by a qualitative hundreds-level count and a public-policy demand; 13 other candidates remain pending evidence. Coverage is geographically and sectorally uneven and is not LexisNexis-equivalent. Five exclusion leads remain provisional and one opened institutional report documents a 20-person action below threshold. No continuity is confirmed.
